verdict.rationale: Productboard's own marketing says it helps teams send only fully-validated features into delivery, and that PMs push prioritized or ready features into delivery tools. That implies the PM controls scope before work starts, but no explicit review or approval gate is documented. Missing for 10: a documented approval or sign-off step on task scope, a review workflow or status gating before delivery, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can review and approve the scope of a task before any work begins on it

citations.quote: only sending fully-validated features into delivery
Push prioritized features into delivery, track their status, and sync key data.
Push features ready for development into GitHub as issues.
